decision: Record and validate observed sample timing rather than planned offsets

reviews.reason: Planned offsets can be inside the workload while scheduler/qrexec delay pushes real sampling outside it. Readiness evidence must describe what actually happened.
A delayed final sample now rejects calibration instead of silently labeling it with the planned timestamp.
No additional qrexec calls, workers, storage, or workload duration are introduced; only local timestamps are retained and validated.
